quincy-price-fix.message:
Fix sub-cent price rendering; diff now reports schema contract changes

format_price rendered a $0.001 endpoint as '$0.00' (two-decimal float
format). It now computes with Decimal and preserves exact sub-cent
precision ('$0.001', '$0.005'), never '$0.00' for a nonzero price.
Regression tests added (aicom review, 2026-10-29).

RouteVerdict also gains the schema/contract distinction alexar76
asked for: each check stores the published schema's field->type
contract map beside its quality score, and compute_diff compares the
two axes separately (schema_score_stability vs contract_stability).
An output field flipping string -> number now produces a named
contract_change entry even when both scores stay 100. Legacy stored
results report contract stability 'unknown'. Verdict scoring is
unchanged.

quincy-persistence.message:
Check-store persistence: resolve DB onto a mounted volume, report storage in /health

The diff memory (prior-check sqlite) lived on the container's
ephemeral disk, so every redeploy silently wiped it — a buyer's
round-2 diff came back 'no prior check on record' after the
2026-10-29 price-fix deploy (alexar76/aicom#13).

Mirror StallRow's pattern: resolve_db_path() picks
ROUTE_VERDICT_DB if set, else /data/route-verdict.db when a
volume is mounted at /data, else the plain relative filename;
durability is measured (nearest existing ancestor is a mount
point), never assumed from the path. Settings gains
db_persistent, and /health reports storage.check_store /
storage.check_db_path so a reset is visible from outside.

Tests: health storage assertion + resolver unit tests (85 pass).

quincy-feed.message:
Recheck feed: free public JSONL of recent check responses at GET /v1/recheck/feed

Every completed check now appends its exact response object to a
recheck_history table in the watch store (recorded inside recheck()
itself, so per-call, pack-spent, and scheduled checks are all
recorded once). The feed serves the last 100, newest first, as
application/x-ndjson — the observatory surface promised to the
aicom survey (alexar76/aicom#13).

Watches that pre-date the history are seeded with one record built
only from the stored watch state (watch id, URL, kind, fingerprint
as current, checked_at); their per-check status/changes/summary
were never stored and are omitted, never reconstructed.

quincy-history.message:
Per-resource check history read + structured field_changes in diffs

- GET /v1/history?resource_url= (free): every stored check for one
  resource, oldest first — the read StallRow's unified timeline
  aggregates. Pure read over the existing checks table.
- compute_diff gains an additive field_changes array
  ({path, op, before, after, severity, category}) derived from the
  comparables and the stored field->type contract maps: a field
  flipping string -> number at an unchanged score now yields a named
  type_changed entry (alexar76/aicom#13). Legacy changes[],
  schema_score_stability and contract_stability keep their meanings.
- Docs: README, skill.md, llms.txt describe the new read.
Tests: 85 -> 93 passed.

quincy-feed-v2.message:
Recheck feed v2, baseline pins/imports, field-level diffs, change webhooks, unified timeline

Aicom improvements 1-5 (alexar76/aicom#13), all additive:
- Feed v2: every history record gains seq, record_id, schema_version
  and a hash chain (prev_hash/record_hash over canonical content);
  legacy rows backfilled deterministically at store open. Default
  GET /v1/recheck/feed body is byte-identical; ?v=2 / ?since_seq= /
  ?watch_id= / ?url= serve envelopes, cursor mode ascending with
  X-Recheck-Feed-* headers exposing the chain head.
- GET /v1/recheck/history[/<record_id>]: envelope reads + stateless
  compare_seq baseline comparison.
- Baseline pins (a pinned snapshot governs the watch's diff) and
  imports (validated by recomputing the schema hash from the
  supplied schema; provenance stored) behind the fleet-internal
  secret, mirroring /v1/internal/claims-history. No public writes.
- field_changes[] beside legacy changes[] in every Recheck result,
  derived from the stored fingerprint components.
- Per-watch change webhooks (internal-secret config): CHANGED only,
  HMAC-SHA256 signed over the raw body, SSRF-checked at config and
  send time, bounded retries, every attempt recorded, dead_letter
  readable via the authenticated deliveries read.
- GET /v1/resource/timeline: Recheck events + RouteVerdict
  /v1/history + latest CDP catalogue snapshot state for one URL,
  sources named, failures degrade to 'unavailable'.
Tests: 467 -> 484 passed.
